496: High critical hit ratio. Ups the user's Speed.
497: The user hardens their skin, sharply raising its Defense.
498: Giant chunks of ice damage the foe. It may flinch.
499: High critical hit ratio. May lower Defense or flinch.
500: Hurls a blizzard-cloaked icicle lance at the foe.
501: Sends a frightful army of ghosts at the foe.
502: Attacks the foe with a towering pillar of light.

stench: May cause a foe to flinch.
flash_fire: Powers up if hit by fire.
overgrow: Ups Grass moves in a pinch.
blaze: Ups Fire moves in a pinch.
torrent: Ups Water moves in a pinch.
swarm: Ups Bug moves in a pinch.
snow_cloak: Ups evasion in Hail or Snow.
unburden: Using a hold item ups Speed.
slow_start: Takes a while to get going.
ice_body: HP recovery in Hail or Snow.
telepathy: Can't be damaged by an ally.
symbiosis: Passes its item to an ally.
berserk: Boosts Sp. Atk at low HP.
cotton_down: Lower Speed of all when hit.
gulp_missile: If hit, spits prey from sea.
steam_engine: Fire or Water hits up Speed.
ice_face: Hail or Snow renew free hit.
perish_body: Foe faints in 3 turns if hit.
wind_rider: Ups Attack if hit by wind.
